note: Card library for the JM Systems Co. weekly Facebook post. The scheduled task picks one card from here and writes a fresh caption around it. Images are served from raw.githubusercontent.com and are live the moment they are pushed — there is no build step.

cards.situation: The function hall is double-booked — two events on the same Saturday, both already paid.
cards.device: calendar grid with a clash on one square

cards.situation: Peak season: forty unread Messenger enquiries, one person answering.
cards.offer: AI assistant add-on, P1,500/month (say plainly it is an add-on)

cards.situation: Phone lost. Every booking lost with it — no copy anywhere.
No record of who still owes a balance after taking many downpayments.
cards.hook: Aminin: may hindi pa bayad. Hindi mo alam kung sino.
cards.device: reservation slip with the balance line left blank
cards.season: any, strongest after a busy booking month

cards.situation: Someone searched for what you sell, in your own town, and you did not appear.
cards.hook: Hindi ka nawawala. Hindi ka lang nahahanap.
cards.device: search results with the competitors anonymised
cards.offer: Starter website, P15,000 (Google Business Profile is the part that answers this)

cards.situation: The same holiday-hours question asked over and over.
cards.device: the same question repeating and fading, with a tally
cards.season: SEASONAL — names Nov 1. Do not use after 2026-11-01 unless the card is remade for the next holiday.
